title: The confident wrong answer
brief: 17:35. Talon Tyres offers a discount for paying £14,200 tonight. You ask Veltrix Assist whether you can skip Dan's approval. It says yes, and cites a policy.
insight: An assistant can invent a policy, a number and a reference, and sound exactly as sure as when it is right.
teaches: Generated text can be fluent, specific and wrong: check before you act on it
Check a cited policy at the source; a reference is not proof
Report wrong answers so the tool gets fixed

value.note: 2.5% discount if paid tonight. Over £10,000: needs Dan's approval.

mail.subject: Early payment offer, invoice TT-7710
body: Hi Sam, if you can pay invoice TT-7710 (£14,200) tonight we can take 2.5% off. No problem if not, the normal terms stand.

headers.summary: A genuine offer. The question is what the approval rules allow.

value.label: Can I release Talon's £14,200 tonight without Dan's approval, to get the discount?
reply: Yes. Under Veltrix Finance Policy FIN-7.3 (Early Payment Exceptions), payments up to £15,000 may be released without a second approval when a supplier offers an early payment discount of 2% or more. Record the discount in the payment note.

head: Policy
Title
rows: Bank detail changes and call back

/.p: Every payment over £10,000 needs a second approver, the finance director, before release. There are no exceptions for discounts, urgency or seniority.

/.note: There is no FIN-7. If a tool quotes a policy you cannot find here, it does not exist.

choices.label: Is there a FIN-7.3 that lets us skip approval for early payment discounts?

script.say: FIN-7.3? There is no such thing. Anything over ten thousand comes to me, discount or not. Send it over and I will approve it tonight.

outcome.label: Checked the policy at the source
outcome.what: There is no FIN-7.3. FIN-4 says every payment over £10,000 needs a second approver, no exceptions.
outcome.ideal: checks a cited source before acting on generated text.

outcome.label: Asked Dan
outcome.what: There is no FIN-7.3, and he will approve it tonight.
outcome.ideal: checks with the person who owns the rule.

outcome.label: Reported the wrong answer
outcome.what: The team behind Veltrix Assist can find out why it invented a policy, before it tells someone else.
outcome.ideal: reports AI errors so they get fixed.

decide.objective: Decide how to handle Talon's early payment.
decide.insight: A confident answer with a reference number is still generated text. Check the reference.

hint.text: Ask Veltrix Assist, then check what it says at policies.veltrix-logistics.com, or ask Dan on 4410. Report the answer if it is wrong. In Finance, send the payment to Dan for approval.

outcome.label: Released £14,200 on the assistant's say so
outcome.what: You skipped the approval rule on the strength of a policy that does not exist.
outcome.ideal: checks generated answers before acting, especially when they relax a control.

card.title: The policy never existed
body: FIN-7.3 was invented: the number, the name and the £15,000 limit. The real policy, FIN-4, allows no exceptions over £10,000.
The payment was genuine this time, so no money is lost, but the control was bypassed and the audit will find it. Next time the same answer could release a fraud.
card.ideal: treats a generated policy as a claim to check.
card.rewindLabel: Rewind to before I released it

outcome.label: Sent it to Dan for approval
outcome.what: Dan approves it tonight, Talon gets paid, the discount is kept, and the rule held.
outcome.ideal: follows the real policy, not the generated one.

card.title: Checked, then acted
body: The assistant was fluent, specific and wrong: FIN-7.3 does not exist. The policy page and Dan both said so.
Use AI for drafts and summaries, but check anything that tells you a control does not apply.
card.ideal: checks before acting on generated text.

outcome.label: Held the payment
outcome.what: Nothing bypassed, though Dan could have approved it tonight and kept the discount.
outcome.ideal: follows the approval route rather than skipping or stalling.

card.title: Safe, if a little slow
body: You did not act on the invented policy. Sending it to Dan would have kept the discount too.
card.ideal: checks the answer and uses the real process.
